final_policy.m6_selection_rule: Compare ratio 0.9 against 0.8 on all 18 large instances and seeds 42/43 in reversed block order. Adopt 0.9 only when the mean paired improvement is positive, wins exceed losses, and no valid paired objective worsens by more than 10%; otherwise retain 0.8. Infeasible instances stay visible but do not enter objective ratios.
final_policy.m2_route_seed_fraction: Auto 0.2 above 20 customers and budgets >= 5 seconds; otherwise 0.
final_policy.m4_seed_search_fraction: Auto 0.2 for 10-20 customers and budgets >= 5 seconds; otherwise 0.
final_policy.m7_stage1_ratio: Auto 0.9 for >=10 customers and budgets >=5 seconds; otherwise 0.75.
final_policy.result_equivalence: Only the automatic M6 stage split changed from the adopted snapshot. Latest large M6 rows use the complete explicit-0.8 seed42 batch. Other final batches have the same effective solver behavior as this release.
